summary: Backend Finance & Operations: 19/19 passed (1 skipped by-design). Frontend: MGMT nav shows Finance & Operations group with Revenue Overview + Site Expenses + Stock Book; rahul (sales BDE) does NOT see the group; site1 (site_manager) sees Site Expenses + Stock Book but NOT Revenue Overview (correct RBAC). Revenue Overview renders period picker, Set Targets, and per-project rows with accrued/received/receivable/expenses/net/target/variance. Stock Book shows material ledger with opening/inward/outward/closing and Ledger buttons. Expenses page shows stat cards + status pills + Final Approve button. Two UI issues: (1) /#/users (admin) does NOT render the assign-projects button — the card-layout renderer people.js has no assignment control; the assign-projects code in config.js is dead / not routed. (2) Management role cannot see a Reject button in expenses UI because reject visibility gates on 'expenses.approve' (accounts only) while management has 'expenses.approve_final'.

minor.issue: Review request expects site_manager to see project-scoped leads, but site_manager role is NOT granted 'leads.view' in DatabaseSeeder.php, so leads-scoping via site_manager returns 403. Either grant leads.view to site_manager or update the requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin cannot open the project-assignment modal from Users & Roles. people.js renders a card layout with only edit + active-toggle icons; the assign-projects button (data-testid=assign-projects-{userId}) and projectForm modal defined in config.js are never invoked. Backend PUT /users/{id}/projects works (verified in pytest).

Reject button visibility uses can('expenses.approve') only. Management (has expenses.approve_final) sees Final Approve but NO Reject button for pending_management rows. Suggest: can('expenses.approve') || can('expenses.approve_final').

action_items: Port the assign-projects button + projectForm modal into /app/laravel-crm/public/assets/js/people.js (card layout) so admin can actually assign projects to users via UI. Currently the feature is only reachable via API.
Update finance-ops.js rowActions() so the Reject button also shows for users with expenses.approve_final (management), OR clarify that only Accounts can reject and Management must send back.
Decide: grant site_manager 'leads.view' permission (per review-request scope test) OR document that site_manager has no leads access.
critical_code_review_comments: config.js contains a users-table + projectForm block (~lines 220-252) that is dead code — /#/users is served by people.js. Remove it or wire it up to avoid drift.
ExpenseController::store validates category in [material,labour,equipment,transport,utilities,other] (singular 'material'); ensure the raise-expense form uses these exact enum values.

Reject-authorization asymmetry: stage-1 approve/reject share expenses.approve; stage-2 uses expenses.approve_final. Consider a dedicated expenses.reject perm or allow reject at any stage the user is authorized on.
Stock item response uses opening_qty / closing_qty (not opening/closing) — keep consistent naming across responses.
Expense API returns { 'expense': {...} } wrapper — consider standardising to { data: ... } across resources for consistency with other endpoints.

rca of the issue: assign-projects UI missing: two different renderers exist for /#/users — config.js (table with assign-projects) and people.js (card layout without). app.js router loads people.js, so the code path adding the diagram-project icon per row is never executed. Reproduction: login as admin → /#/users → only pen (edit) icon and Active toggle appear per card; no button matching [data-testid^='assign-projects-']. Fix: add an assign-projects-{u.id} <button> to each user card in people.js and lift the projectForm() modal into people.js (or a shared module) preserving data-testid values (proj-cb-{pid}, proj-save).
